prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production WORLD MAP terrain texture, ground-land, for an original dark-fantasy mercenary game.
Input images: Image 1 and Image 2 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets. Match their broad irregular black-ink brush marks, dry-brush texture and muted earthy wash. Do not include the reference subjects.
Primary request: Generate one 1024x1024 square opaque seamless tileable top-down countryside texture, late autumn viewed from far above. Muted meadows, sparse scattered tiny shrubs, faint irregular field patches; olive-grey, dusty ochre, brown earth, restrained umber ink. Very low contrast and subdued small-scale detail so map site icons stand out. Sparse black marks, not heavy graphic outlines around fields. Soft flat overcast light, no perspective horizon, no central focal point, no roads, buildings, people, mountains or large features.
Composition: fill the complete square edge-to-edge, even visual density. Truly seamless repeat in both horizontal and vertical directions: corresponding opposite borders must continue the same terrain marks and colors. No border, no vignette, no edge fade, no margin, no grid.
Constraints: original design only; no imitation of existing games or artists; no text, letters, numbers, logos, symbols or watermarks. One terrain image only, not a sheet. Opaque everywhere.

Built-in refinement prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: seamless repeating 1024x1024 opaque world-map ground-land terrain texture.
Edit target: the attached original generated terrain. Keep its broad dry black ink and muted olive-grey/ochre/umber wash, distant late-autumn meadows, small shrubs and faint field patches. Repair ONLY its repeatability and slightly quiet the contrast for small site icons.
Critical change: make the texture genuinely seamless in both axes, with no visible seam when the square repeats in a 3x3 grid. LEFT and RIGHT boundaries must have exactly corresponding grass, shrubs, ink strokes and colors; TOP and BOTTOM boundaries must correspond too. Continue features naturally across each paired edge. Preserve consistent visual density, avoid large focal objects, no bands or blurred edge strips, no mirror symmetry, no visible grid. Pure overhead countryside seen from far above, no buildings or people. Full image filled edge-to-edge, opaque, square 1024x1024.
Constraints: original artwork only, no imitation of any existing game or artist. No text, letters, numbers, logos, symbols, watermarks, border, vignette, empty margin or edge fade. Output ONE seamless texture, not a tiled preview or collage.
model: image_gen (built-in; underlying model identifier not exposed)
